purpose: Reusable Windows silent scheduled-task primitives: pythonw.exe resolution, Hidden Task Scheduler registration rendering, schtasks silent classification, and CREATE_NO_WINDOW child-process helpers so consumer repos do not fork noisy console cron.
core_owns: read-only due-time/child/focus evidence audit with independent functional-state classification
opt-in SILENT_BACKGROUND Python descendant guard, interaction deferral and AppData receipts
adapters_own: consumer job registries and script paths
live Task Scheduler apply authorization on operator workstations
Node subprocess adapter using windowsHide with unchanged interactive launch path
non_goals: owning qBit or TokenCorridor product tick scripts
replacing consumer Work Graph / wake selection logic
claiming live Task Scheduler registration from CI
switching consumers from Task Scheduler to app-owned timers or changing cadence
claiming arbitrary GUI grandchildren or fullscreen focus are silent from a launcher receipt
proof_ceiling: Synthetic fixtures prove pythonw detection, registry validation, and PowerShell render shape. Live Register-ScheduledTask requires an interactive Windows operator session with --apply. Supplied evidence classification can report due-time observations and explicit child/fullscreen certification gates; it cannot authenticate receipts or exercise the Windows focus session. Python/Node execution classes and reinstall preflight are opt-in consumer contracts; no consumer install or live descendant/focus certification is implied.
